recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球前驅細胞增多，一個大型細胞正處於有絲分裂，多個前驅細胞染色質開放但細胞質已呈多色性（核質不同步），右下可見含 Howell-Jolly 樣核碎片的晚期細胞與不規則核碎裂，符合巨母紅血球性貧血的無效造血。
features: Erythroid hyperplasia with numerous enlarged erythroid precursors
Large cell with mitotic figure and abundant blue cytoplasm (upper left)
Polychromatic erythroblasts retaining open, stippled chromatin (nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony)
Late erythroid cell containing a round dense nuclear remnant (Howell-Jolly-like body)
Irregular, fragmented dense nuclear material suggesting karyorrhexis/dyserythropoiesis
Background oval macrocytes and teardrop forms
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid hyperplasia with enlarged erythroid precursors displaying open, stippled chromatin that is immature relative to their polychromatic cytoplasm. A large precursor in mitosis is present, and a late erythroid cell contains a round dense nuclear remnant resembling a Howell-Jolly body, with nearby irregular fragmented nuclear material consistent with karyorrhexis. Background red cells include oval macrocytes and occasional teardrop forms. Findings are consistent with megaloblastic anemia with ineffective erythropoiesis.

ddx.vs: Karyorrhexis and nuclear fragments also occur in MDS, which is separated by multilineage dysplasia, clonal cytogenetics and failure to respond to B12/folate.
CDA shows binucleated/multinucleated erythroblasts and internuclear chromatin bridges with normal-sized granulocytic precursors.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of immature proerythroblasts with vacuoles rather than a maturing erythroid series.
Howell-Jolly bodies in hyposplenism appear in mature red cells of the blood without megaloblastic marrow precursors.
